summary: Net Worth History (snapshot upsert + GET /history) + Smart Suggestions deep-links tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 6/6 PASS in new test_my_money_history.py: snapshot row written on PUT, same-month upsert keeps count=1, multi-month seeded periods returned oldest-first, ?months=N truncates, user A's history excludes user B's rows. Frontend Playwright PASS for all 4 flows: (1) /my-money wealth-history-card renders LineChart with title 'Wealth Growth (3 months)' once 3 snapshots exist; (2) /clients renders suggestion-link-{client_id}-{i} <Link> wrappers with hrefs '/document-reader' (no_docs, no client_id per spec), '/compliance-notes?client_id=...', '/email-generator?client_id=...'; (3) /clients/{id}/360 suggestions-panel rows are all <A> tags wrapping the WHOLE row with ArrowRight chevron; (4) clicking no_touchpoint row navigates to /email-generator?client_id=3474c87b... AND EmailGenerator's data-testid='select-client' pre-selects 'Test Client'. Code-confirmed all_good falls through to <span> (no linkMap entry).
critical_code_review_comments: my_money.py snapshot upsert uses compound key (user_id, period) with period='YYYY-MM' — correct dedup.
Snapshot includes total_assets/total_liabilities/net_worth + tfsa/ra fields, captured_at ISO string — LineChart consumes these directly. Good.
GET /history projects out _id and user_id, sorts ascending by period, limits to max(months, 1) — clean, no ObjectId leakage.
MyMoney.jsx parallel fetch (dashboard + history) via Promise.all with .catch fallback — graceful degradation if history endpoint errors.
MyMoney wealth-history-card gated on history.length >= 2 — correct; verified hidden when single snapshot.
ClientsPage suggestion-link uses onClick={e.stopPropagation()} to prevent parent row click bubbling — correct UX.
Client360 suggestions-panel wraps the WHOLE row in <Link> using react-router Link with relative paths — uses ArrowRight chevron only when href exists — matches spec.
no_docs deep-link is /document-reader WITHOUT client_id (per problem spec — DocumentReader doesn't have a per-client filter); other actionable kinds correctly carry client_id query param.
all_good is not in linkMap on either page → falls through to <span> on /clients and is filtered out via suggestions[0]?.kind !== 'all_good' guard on Client360 — clean.
